description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git checkout functionality within subdirectories, including setup, checkout operations using relative paths, and failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, executes the provided commands, and verifies their success.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal Git timestamp to ensure unique commit times.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Adds specified files or directories to the staging area.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Commits the staged changes with a message.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Checks out files or directories from the specified commit (HEAD).

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the subsequent command fails as expected.
